idea-plugin.name: Doris SQL LSP
idea-plugin.description: Doris SQL language support backed by the repository's Native doris-lsp server. LSP transport and protocol integration are provided by LSP4IJ. Managed binaries are downloaded from the public GitHub Releases repository with SHA-256 verification and a configured local-command fallback.

server.name: Doris SQL
server.description: Native doris-lsp server over stdio; managed GitHub Releases download with local executable fallback.
